CORDIS Projects

Knitwear product passports for circular SMEs

Acronym
KNITPASS
Grant agreement ID
999000001
Start date
1 September 2023
End date
31 August 2026
Funded under
Horizon Europe - Cluster 4 - Digital, Industry and Space

Objective

KNITPASS develops a digital product passport (DPP) for knitwear made by small and medium-sized enterprises. The project defines the data points a knitted garment needs under the Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation: fibre composition, yarn origin, dyeing and finishing steps, care and repair instructions and recycled content. It builds open tools so small-batch knitters can create passports from their existing production data, and pilots them with eight knitwear makers in four countries.

  • Breiatelier Voorbeeld BV — Netherlands — Participant
